wizard.headerSubtitle: A 4-step wizard to get the Ninja AI Framework running on your machine.

descriptions.envCheck: Verify the Kage Runtime and installed agents.
descriptions.testConnection: Test the connection with the model provider.
descriptions.createWorkspace: Initialize the first work session on the active workspace.
descriptions.tour: Walk through the key views of the Forge Console.

wizard.errorGeneric: Something went wrong contacting the runtime.
wizard.envErrorHint: The runtime listens on port 3141. Start it with pnpm ninja and retry.
wizard.connErrorHint: The test queries {endpoint} on the runtime (port 3141). Start it with pnpm ninja and retry.
wizard.doctorNone: No agent clients (Cursor, VS Code, Claude…) detected on this machine. You can continue; agent installation is managed from Arsenal.
wizard.connBody: The Kage Runtime responds and the Model Gateway has its catalog loaded. You can fine-tune providers with the real connection test in Settings.
wizard.workspaceBody: The active workspace is ready to receive missions from Mission Control.
wizard.workspaceIntro: Create the first work session on the runtime's active workspace. This is the step that leaves the engine ready to orchestrate agents.
wizard.tourIntro: All set. These are the four key views of the Forge Console:

tour.missionControl: Operational state of the engine, metrics and recent tasks.
tour.office: The digital office: agents working in real time.
tour.arsenal: Tools and skills available to the agents.
